##S1P1: Total number of TUNEL+ spots in neuropil of one-eyed versus WT at 6 dpf
```{r}
#load the data
TUNEL_neuropil <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/Fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures_Supplemental/TotalTUNEL_inc_neuropil_6dpf.csv")

neuropil_plot <-ggplot(TUNEL_neuropil) +
  aes(x = Innerv, y = Total_neuropil) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape =NA, ) +
  #geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  geom_point(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch = 21, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width =0.2, height =0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("black", "gray"))+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("Total neuropil TUNEL+ spots")+
  ylim(0, 100)+
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("intact", "one-eyed")), 
    method="t.test", 
    label = "p.signif") #p.signif here will give you ** or n.s.

print(neuropil_plot)
```

```{r}
ggsave("neuropil_plot.png", neuropil_plot, path=NULL,
       scale = 1, width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

```{r}

TUNEL_neuropil %>%
  group_by(Innerv) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_L = mean(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.L`),
    median_L = median(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.L`),
    sd_L = sd(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.L`),
    mean_R = mean(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.R`),
    median_R = median(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.R`),
    sd_R = sd(`TUNEL.neuropil.side.R`),

  )
```

```{r}

```
#S1P2 - paired analysis of TUNEL+ spots on right and left in one-eyed larvae
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#(re)load data
TUNEL_neuropil<-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures_Supplemental/TotalTUNEL_inc_neuropil_6dpf.csv")
View(TUNEL_neuropil)

#neuropil L v R TUNEL+ cells
#first reshape data
TUNEL_neuropil1 <- TUNEL_neuropil %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("TUNEL.neuropil.side.L", "TUNEL.neuropil.side.R"),
               names_to = "neuropil_side",
               values_to = "TUNEL_neuropil_side")%>%
  mutate(neuropil_side = case_when(neuropil_side =="TUNEL.neuropil.side.L" ~"left", neuropil_side == "TUNEL.neuropil.side.R" ~"right"))%>%
  mutate(neuropil_side = factor(neuropil_side, levels = c("left", "right")))
View(TUNEL_neuropil1)

```

#run paired t-test for sides within each one-eyed and intact brain
```{r}
run_paired_ttest <- function(data, group) {
  wide_data <- data %>%
    filter(Innerv == group) %>%
    dplyr::select(Embryo, neuropil_side, TUNEL_neuropil_side) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = neuropil_side, values_from = TUNEL_neuropil_side)
  
  t.test(wide_data$left, wide_data$right, paired = TRUE)
}

one_eyed_ttest <- run_paired_ttest(TUNEL_neuropil1, "one-eyed")
intact_ttest   <- run_paired_ttest(TUNEL_neuropil1, "intact")

print("One-eyed group: Paired t-test results")
print(one_eyed_ttest)

print("Intact group: Paired t-test results")
print(intact_ttest)
```
##Plot showing paired nature of data points
```{r}
neuropilside_plot_paired <- ggplot(TUNEL_neuropil1) +
  aes(x = neuropil_side, y = TUNEL_neuropil_side) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Innerv, strip.position = "bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  # Add lines connecting paired points (using Embryo as the grouping variable)
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(Embryo, Innerv)), color = "gray60", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Add points on top of lines
  #geom_point(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch = 21, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width =0.02, height =0)) +
  geom_beeswarm(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch = 21, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8)+
  xlab("") +
  ylab("TUNEL+ spots per neuropil") +
  ylim(0, 48) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("left", "right")), 
    method = "t.test", paired = TRUE, 
    label = "p.signif" #"p" will print actual p-value
  )
print(neuropilside_plot_paired)
```

```{r}
ggsave("neuropilside_plot_paired_ns.png", neuropilside_plot_paired, path=NULL, 
         scale = 1, width = 14, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

###S2P1 box plots of EdU chased into HuC
```{r}
SHdata <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/EdU_pulsechase_HuC/SH_Thesis Data_copy.csv")
View(SHdata)

SHdata$dpf <-factor(SHdata$dpf, levels = c("8", "10", "12")) #comment this line out when running lm so that dpf is numerical
SHdata$geno <- factor(SHdata$geno, levels = c("WT", "LAK"))

```

```{r}
#stat manual values from below
stat_manualSH <-tibble::tribble(
  ~dpf, ~group1,  ~group2,  ~p.adj,
  "8",  "WT",    "LAK",  0.0045,
  "10",   "WT",    "LAK",  0.0015,
  "12", "WT", "LAK", 0.0027
) %>%
  mutate(
    dpf = factor(dpf, levels = c("8", "10", "12")),
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    y.position = 0.98   # adjust based on your beeswarm/error bar heights per facet
  )
```

```{r}
#proportion over time boxplot from Sara H
plot1 <- ggplot(SHdata, aes(x = geno, y= proportion))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape =NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+

               labeller = labeller(dpf = c("8" = "6 h post EdU pulse", "10" = "2 d post EdU pulse", "12" = "4 d post EdU pulse")))+theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=11))+
  labs(x= "Genotype", y= "Proportion (EdU+HuC+) / Edu+ ") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=expression(WT, italic(lak)))+
  ylim (0, 1)+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_manualSH, label = "p.adj.signif", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position")
  
  
  #geom_pwc(method = "wilcox.test")
#plot1_revised <- ggadjust_pvalue(plot1, p.adjust.method = "holm", label = "p.adj.signif") #"p.adj" here will give you the values
  #OR
 #stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("WT", "LAK")),method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif")
            
plot1

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave("TectumF9_full_EdUHuCproportion_revised.png", plot1, path=NULL, 
         scale = 1, width = 16, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

# summary stats
group_by(SHdata, geno, dpf) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count= n(),
    mean = mean(total_edu, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(total_edu, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(total_edu, na.rm = TRUE))

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# 1. Fit the beta Regression Model
# The logit link naturally handles variance that scales with the mean
mod_EdUHuC  <- gam(proportion ~ geno * dpf, family = betar(link = "logit"), data = SHdata)
mod_EdUHuC0 <- gam(proportion ~ 1, family = betar(link = "logit"), data = SHdata)

# 2. Check the Model Summary for Interaction Effects
summary(mod_EdUHuC)
anova(mod_EdUHuC0, mod_EdUHuC, test = "F")   # overall test
AIC(mod_EdUHuC0, mod_EdUHuC)

# 3. Post-Hoc Comparisons
emm_EdUHuC <- emmeans(mod_EdUHuC, ~ geno | dpf, type = "response")
cons_EdUHuC <-contrast(emm_EdUHuC, "revpairwise", by = "dpf")
summary(cons_EdUHuC, adjust = "holm", by = NULL)

```

###S4 - body length
##Looks like Elaine kept track of batches so try SuperPlot here:
```{r, echo=FALSE}
BodyLength<-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figures_Supplemental/ElaineFishLength.csv")
View(BodyLength)

```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#first change column name of "Group" to "Batch" and make sure that the numbers aren't read as continuous.
BodyLength <- BodyLength %>%
  rename(Batch_length = Group) %>%
  mutate(Batch_length = factor(Batch_length))

SuperLength <- BodyLength %>% group_by(Innerv, LvD, Batch_length) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop")
SuperLength
SuperLengthSummary <- summarySE(SuperLength, measurevar="Size", groupvars=c("LvD","Innerv"))
SuperLengthSummary

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
group_by(SuperLength, LvD, Innerv) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean = mean(Size, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(Size, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Size, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Specify light condition
L <- SuperLength$LvD == "light"
SuperLength[L,]
#Specify dark condition
SuperLength[!L,]
#Specify intact condition
E <- SuperLength$Innerv == "intact"
SuperLength[E,]
#Specify enucleated condition
SuperLength[!E,]
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Before anova, you have to (1) check for normal distribution and (2) check for equal variance
# Check for normal distribution
with(SuperLength[L,], shapiro.test(Size[Innerv == "intact"])) #p-value = 0.1954
with(SuperLength[L,], shapiro.test(Size[Innerv == "one-eyed"])) #p-value = 0.3634
with(SuperLength[!L,], shapiro.test(Size[Innerv == "intact"])) #p-value = 0.1896
with(SuperLength[!L,], shapiro.test(Size[Innerv == "one-eyed"])) #p-value = 0.8836
#p-value > 0.05 implies that the distribution of the data are not significantly different from normal distribution.
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Variance test
leveneTest(Size ~ Innerv*LvD, data = SuperLength) #p-value = 0.3916
#p-value > 0.05 implies that the variances are not significantly different from each other
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#SUPER ANOVA & Tukey for Super Plot Length LvD --> only batch means
aov.SuperLengthLvD <- aov(Size ~ Innerv * LvD, data = SuperLength)
summary(aov.SuperLengthLvD)
TukeyHSD(aov.SuperLengthLvD, which = "Innerv:LvD")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
omega_squared(aov.SuperLengthLvD,
  #partial = FALSE,
  ci = 0.95,
  alternative = "greater",
  verbose = TRUE)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#need this for the stats on the SuperPlot
stat_manual_length <-tibble::tribble(
  ~LvD,     ~group1,     ~group2,     ~p.adj,
  "light",  "intact",    "one-eyed",  0.212,
  "dark",   "intact",    "one-eyed",  0.862
) %>%
  mutate(
    LvD = factor(LvD, levels = c("light", "dark")),
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    y.position = 7.9   # adjust based on your beeswarm/error bar heights per facet
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
BodyLength$LvD <- factor(BodyLength$LvD,
                          levels = c("light", "dark"))
SuperLength$LvD <- factor(SuperLength$LvD,
                           levels = c("light", "dark"))
SuperLengthSummary$LvD <- factor(SuperLengthSummary$LvD,
                                  levels = c("light", "dark"))

BodyLength$Innerv <- factor(BodyLength$Innerv,
                             levels = c("intact", "one-eyed"))
SuperLength$Innerv <- factor(SuperLength$Innerv,
                              levels = c("intact", "one-eyed"))
SuperLengthSummary$Innerv <- factor(SuperLengthSummary$Innerv,
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
Supp_LengthLLvD <- ggplot(SuperLength, aes(x = Innerv, y = Size)) + 
  geom_beeswarm(data = BodyLength, cex = 2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, dodge.width = 0.65, aes(shape = Batch_length, fill = Batch_length))+
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 3.5, size = 3, alpha = 0.95, dodge.width = 0.25, aes(shape = Batch_length, fill = Batch_length)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#0072B2", "#F0E442", "#D55E00")) +
  facet_wrap(~LvD, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x") +
  xlab("Innervation Status") +
  ylab("Body Length") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  geom_errorbar(data = SuperLengthSummary, aes(ymin = Size - se, ymax = Size + se), size = 0.7, width = .15) +
  stat_summary(data = SuperLength, aes(x = Innerv, y = Size), fun = median, 
               geom = "crossbar", width = 0.3, size = 0.25) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_manual_length, label = "p.adj.signif", 
                     xmin = "group1", 
                     xmax = "group2",

print(Supp_LengthLLvD)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~LvD, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x")+
  #ylim(1.2e06,8.7e06)+
  xlab("Innervation Status")+
  ylab(bquote('DAPI-stained volume '(µm^3)))+ 
  geom_pwc(method = "t.test",
             label = "p.adj.signif")
print(SuppFigDAPIVol)
```

###S7 - EdU incorporation in XAV939 treated larvae (reviewer request)
```{r}
# Load data
spots <- read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/Fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/0_2026_submission/0_TectalGrowth_Figures for resubmission/XAV939 new Supplemental Fig 7/xav939_reviewer request.csv")

str(spots)
head(spots)
```

```{r set-columns}
# EDIT THESE to match your spreadsheet headers and treatment labels

spots$Spots <- spots$Total  # new name = old name, changed whats in csv to match whats in code
         
# The first level is the reference group and appears first on the x-axis
spots$Treatment <- factor(spots$Treatment,
                          levels = c("DMSO", "xav939"))

# Drop any rows with a missing count, and confirm there are exactly two groups
spots <- spots %>% filter(!is.na(Spots), !is.na(Treatment))
table(spots$Treatment)
```

## Statistics for xavSpots
```{r summary-stats}
# n, mean, median, SD per treatment
spots %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    count  = n(),
    mean   = mean(Spots, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(Spots, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(Spots, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r wilcoxon}
# Wilcoxon rank-sum test for two independent groups.
# paired = FALSE is the default; do NOT use paired = TRUE unless the same fish is in both groups.
# Tied counts are common with spot data and trigger a warning about exact p-values;
# exact = FALSE uses the normal approximation and silences it.
wilcox.test(Spots ~ Treatment, data = spots, exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE)

```

```{r effect-size}
# Rank-biserial correlation: the effect size that matches a Wilcoxon test
# (the earlier file used Hedges' g, which assumes roughly normal data)
rank_biserial(Spots ~ Treatment, data = spots)

# Alternative from rstatix:
#wilcox_effsize(spots, Spots ~ Treatment)
```

## Plots for xavSpots
```{r graph, echo=FALSE}

SpotsPlot <- ggplot(spots, aes(x = Treatment, y = Spots))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.3)+
  xlab("Treatment")+
  ylab("Total Number of EdU+ Cells")+ ylim(-0.09, 80)+
  geom_pwc(method = "t.test", label = "p.signif")

print(SpotsPlot)
```

```{r save-plot, echo=FALSE}
ggsave("SpotsPlot.png", SpotsPlot, path = NULL,
       scale = 1, width = 10, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = NULL)
```
